entities.summary: Takahiro Anno (b. 1990-12-01, Bunkyō-ku) was a military leader or commander of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Bunkyō-ku and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, merchants & economists, asia.
